# Runbook prompts

Task-shaped runbooks for agents, one per file, named `*.prompt.md` (pattern
from
[frostyard/core ADR-0018](https://github.com/frostyard/core/blob/main/docs/adr/0018-org-wide-agent-instruction-and-knowledge-surfaces.md);
adopted here by
[ADR-0012](../../docs/adr/0012-acmm-conformance-via-canonical-aliases.md)).
Rules live in [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md); a runbook here is the
*procedure* for one recurring task, not policy.

| Prompt | Task |
| --- | --- |
| [review.prompt.md](review.prompt.md) | Review a pull request against the repo rubric |
| [issue-triage.prompt.md](issue-triage.prompt.md) | Triage a new issue or bug report |
